description: A colour-coded waveform: one colour for each pixel of the derived-media peaks (ADR 0069, which stay derived media and are not copied here), from the frames series (hue from the spectral centroid between limits enrich/hue_range.py can set from a set of recordings, or from the pitch-class profile, lightness from RMS level), a palette describing the mapping, and a PNG preview of the whole recording.

colour.description: red, green, blue for each pixel of the derived-media peaks named by the parameters, row k centred half a pixel into pixel k

palette.description: the mapping, the decibel range lightness spans, and legend stops (archive-colour-palette/2, fields in README.md)

preview.description: the whole recording as an RGBA image, transparent behind the waveform
